review_text_anonymized: Removal of cash on delivery makes ordering difficult for users who avoid online payments; fees and food prices also feel expensive.
Order was marked delivered without being received, and repeated complaints did not receive a proper resolution.
Items were misplaced during delivery and customer support was difficult to reach or unhelpful.
Support chatbot repeatedly gave scripted responses and offered no clear path to reach a human agent.
App prices were perceived as much higher than store prices, with additional packing charges and taxes.
Order was cancelled after difficulty contacting the rider, and the customer reported not receiving the order amount back.
Delivery partners were sometimes assigned from far away, causing delays; cancellation could incur a full charge and customer support was difficult to reach.
High platform costs, packaging charges, incomplete orders, poor portions, and limited ways to verify missing items were reported.
Food listings and portion descriptions were perceived as misleading, with higher prices and insufficient sizing information.
The app was considered reliable with good delivery, but the reviewer wanted more affordable prices and consistent food quality.
The service was described as reliable, convenient, and easy to use; suggested additions included parcel services, groceries, and a unified membership.
The app was praised for being easy to use, fast and reliable delivery, useful restaurant ratings and menus, and good overall experience.
